checksums.name: global_header_sum8_complement
checksums.formula_detail: CK = ~(sum of RAM G+1..G+7) & 0xFF, stored at RAM G+0 (file offset 7 due to per-word byte reversal). Equivalent invariant: sum(file bytes 0..7) == 0xFF. Computed by FUN_08000770, checked by FUN_080007bc.

checksums.name: slot_sum8_complement
checksums.formula_detail: CK = ~(sum of RAM S+1..S+127) & 0xFF, stored at RAM S+0. Per-slot file stored offsets: slot0=15, slot1=143, slot2=271 (word-reversed first word). Validity also requires RAM S+2==0x01. Computed/checked by FUN_08000240.

io_driver_functions.notes: DMA3 engine: programs DMA3 SAD/DAD/CNT (0x040000D4/D8/DC), count|0x80000000, polls CNT busy 0x8000. Used for both directions to 0x0D000000 (EEPROM).
EEPROM read one 64-bit word: address bitstream via DMA, then DMA back 0x44 halfwords, unpack 4x u16 MSB-first.
EEPROM write one 64-bit word: packs 4x u16 + address MSB-first, DMA length addr_bits+0x43, busy-polls 0x0D000000 bit0.
Verify: read-back via FUN_0829a644 and compare 4 halfwords; 0 ok / 0x8000 mismatch. Device-level verify, not the data checksum.
Write+verify with up to 3 retries (FUN_0829a6f4 + FUN_0829a868).
Set EEPROM word cursor: cursor = byte_offset >> 3.
Block read in 8-byte words via FUN_0829a644; returns 1 ok / 0 fail.
Block write in 8-byte words via FUN_0829a8c0; returns 1 ok / 0 fail.
SaveGlobalHeader: CK=~sum(G+0..G+6), write 8 bytes. Checksum routine for global header.
LoadGlobalHeader: read 8, check CK + marker G+7==0x03, else init (FUN_08000388) + save (FUN_08000770).
LoadOrRepairSlot(slot): read 128 from slot*0x80+8, check CK + S+2==0x01, else FUN_0800030c init + recompute CK + write 128. Both reader and repair-writer.
InitSlot RAM: zero-fill, S+1=0xFF, S+2=0x01, u32@S+8=1, mask 21 records.

fields.name: global_marker_version
fields.update_mechanism: Constant 0x03 written at RAM G+7 by InitGlobalHeader; file offset 0 via per-word byte reversal. Load rejects header unless RAM G+7==0x03.
fields.evidence: FUN_08000388 writes 3 at +7; FUN_080007bc checks [7]==3; both savs have 0x03 at file 0x00; RAM frame G+7=0x03 in verification output.

fields.name: global_G6_current_slot

fields.name: global_G5
fields.update_mechanism: RAM G+5, init 1. Getter FUN_080008c0 consumed by FUN_080009c8 (passed to FUN_0825b3f0). Semantics unknown.

fields.name: global_G4_0x30
fields.update_mechanism: RAM G+4, init 0x30. Getter FUN_080008a8 consumed by FUN_080009c8 (passed to FUN_0828cf80). Semantics unknown.

fields.name: global_G3_0x20
fields.update_mechanism: RAM G+3, init 0x20. Getter FUN_08000890 consumed by FUN_080009c8 (passed to FUN_0828cc20). Semantics unknown.

fields.name: global_G2_flag
fields.update_mechanism: RAM G+2. Init 0; FUN_08000874 sets it to constant 1 whenever G+1 is written. Only byte that changed between captures (file 0x05, PACKET probe offset). Flag, not proven counter.
fields.evidence: FUN_08000874 sets +2=1; FUN_08000884 reads +2; sav diff 0x05: 00->01 with checksum 0xAB->0xAA; PACKET mutation probe at 0x5 reverted.

fields.name: global_G1_selection
fields.update_mechanism: RAM G+1, init 0. FUN_08000874 stores selection value; FUN_08000850 reads it; FUN_080009c8 indexes pointer table by it; FUN_08244d08 compares it to 0..2. Selection index 0..2 (exact meaning, e.g. language/profile, unproven).
fields.evidence: FUN_08000874/FUN_08000850/FUN_080009c8/FUN_08244d08 bodies; sav file[6]=0x00 (RAM G+1 via reversal).

fields.name: global_checksum
fields.update_mechanism: RAM G+0 = ~(sum G+1..G+7)&0xFF; recomputed on every header save. File offset 7 via reversal.
fields.evidence: FUN_08000770/FUN_080007bc code; Python: stored AB/AA == computed AB/AA on both files; sum(file0..7)=0xFF.

fields.name: slot_checksum
fields.update_mechanism: RAM S+0 = ~(sum S+1..S+127)&0xFF per slot (slot0/1/2 file offsets 15/143/271). Recomputed only on slot repair-write in corpus.
fields.evidence: FUN_08000240 code; Python: stored FE == computed FE for all 3 slots in both files (RAM frame).

fields.name: slot_S1_ff
fields.update_mechanism: RAM S+1 set to 0xFF by InitSlot. Meaning unknown. File offset shown for slot0 (14); slot1/2 at 142/270.
fields.evidence: FUN_0800030c writes 0xFF at +1; RAM-frame slot byte S+1=0xFF in verification.

fields.name: slot_valid_marker
fields.update_mechanism: RAM S+2 set to 0x01 by InitSlot; load requires S+2==0x01 else re-init. File offset shown for slot0 (13); slot1/2 at 141/269.
fields.evidence: FUN_0800030c +2=1; FUN_08000240 checks +2==1; RAM S+2=0x01 all slots both files.

fields.name: slot_reserved_u32_S4
fields.update_mechanism: RAM S+4 u32 zeroed by InitSlot. File offset approximate: RAM S+4..S+7 word-reverses to file slot0 offsets 16..19 reversed per word. Meaning unknown.
fields.evidence: FUN_0800030c u32@+4=0; sav slot words all zero there.

fields.name: slot_u32_S8_one
fields.update_mechanism: RAM S+8 u32 set to 1 by InitSlot (file: 0x01 at slot base+15, i.e. 23/151/279, due to reversal). Meaning unknown.
fields.evidence: FUN_0800030c u32@+8=1; verification u32@S+8=0x1 all slots.

fields.name: slot_records_21x4
fields.update_mechanism: RAM S+0x0C..S+0x5F: 21 records x 4B. InitSlot masks rec bytes (&0xF0, &0x80). FUN_0800083c reads u32 at current slot S+0x0C. File offsets are word-permuted (record area starts near file slot0 offset 19). Semantics unknown; no gameplay writer in corpus.
fields.evidence: FUN_0800030c masking loop (21 iterations, stride 4) and FUN_0800083c; sav records all zero so semantics unobservable.

fields.name: slot_tail_S60
fields.update_mechanism: RAM S+0x60..S+0x7F zero-filled on init; covered by slot checksum; never written by traced code. File offset shown for slot0 start of this RAM range (word-permuted).
fields.evidence: Zero in both savs; no code reference beyond zero-fill and checksum coverage.

fields.name: erased_tail
fields.update_mechanism: Never written: EEPROM erased state. No code addresses bytes >= 0x188 (max is slot2 end 264+128=392).
fields.evidence: Both savs all-0xFF at 0x188..0x1FF; geometry 8+3*128=392 from FUN_08000240/FUN_0828b228.

fuzzing_targets.predicted_effect: Header stays valid if FUN_08000884 consumer only tests ==1 vs any-nonzero; compare boot behavior/RAM G+2 against value 0x01 case to distinguish flag from counter.

fuzzing_targets.mutation: Change marker file 0x00 (RAM G+7) from 0x03 to 0x04 with checksum repair at file 0x07
fuzzing_targets.predicted_effect: Header rejected despite valid checksum (marker check); defaults rebuilt. Proves marker is independently enforced.

fuzzing_targets.mutation: Clear slot0 valid marker (file 0x0D, RAM S+2) 0x01->0x00 with slot checksum repair at file 0x0F (recompute over reversed frame)
fuzzing_targets.predicted_effect: Slot0 re-initialized on load despite valid checksum, proving marker enforcement; other slots untouched.

fuzzing_targets.predicted_effect: If slot still loads, S+8 is data; if re-initialized or behavior changes, S+8 is structural. Watch RAM slot+8 after load.

open_questions: Gameplay progress writer: no RAM-slot-to-EEPROM flush outside init/repair exists in the 291-function corpus; which function writes progress records (S+0x0C) and when is it flushed?
Slot record semantics: 21x4B records at S+0x0C are all-zero in empty saves; need a progressed save (paired .ss state) to map them.
Global field semantics: G+3=0x20, G+4=0x30, G+5=1 (consumed by FUN_080009c8 chain) and G+1 selection meaning (language vs profile) unproven.

G+2: flag set to constant 1 by FUN_08000874 vs incrementing counter — only 0->1 observed; who flushes the header after FUN_08000874 mutates RAM, since FUN_08000770 is only called from FUN_080007bc in corpus?
Absolute RAM mirror addresses: all save-struct pointers are unresolved _DAT_ literal-pool entries in the decompilation; EWRAM base (expected 0x02xxxxxx) cannot be pinned from this corpus.
FUN_080006f4 (LoadAll) has no caller in corpus; boot entry path outside trace set.
EEPROM descriptor literals (word count at desc+4, address bits at desc+8) not recovered; 64-word/512B size inferred from image size and >>3 addressing.
